Pree, I couldn't find a ticket number for the Marrow Fieldworks West yard Door 2 double-booking.

The closest thing I can see is in #central-random, which you're in. Tobias wrote that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841. But that message is about his dealer account and the Plains depots, not Marrow Fieldworks, and the export has no reliable date. So #8841 may not be your ticket. I'd check with Tobias before you use it on the call.

I also checked #central-team and didn't find the Marrow Fieldworks Door 2 ticket there.
